description: Defines the MetricsReceiver class with static methods for logging various metrics related to virtual machine start/stop, device boot, and lock screen events within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: MetricsReceiver
classes.description: A class providing static methods to log different metrics events such as VM start/stop, device boot, and lock screen within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: LogMetricsVMStart
methods.description: Logs metrics related to the start of a virtual machine.

methods.name: LogMetricsVMStop
methods.description: Logs metrics related to the stopping of a virtual machine.

methods.name: LogMetricsDeviceBoot
methods.description: Logs metrics related to device boot events.

methods.name: LogMetricsLockScreen
